howItWorks.title: How UniMarket works on campus
howItWorks.subtitle: From registration to deal completion, every step is designed for campus safety and transparency.

step1.title: Sign up & get verified
step1.desc: Register with your credentials and submit your AAU Student ID. Administrators verify your account before you can list items.

step2.title: List an item or post a request
step2.desc: Take photos, set your price in ETB, or post a demand describing exactly what textbook or service you are seeking.

step3.title: Chat and agree on handover
step3.desc: Send private messages safely within UniMarket. Agree on a convenient campus meetup spot like the library or cafeteria.

step4.title: Meet, confirm together & rate
step4.desc: Inspect the item, exchange payment in person (cash or Telebirr/transfer), both tap confirm, and rate the deal 1-5 stars.

trust.title: A marketplace built around verified trust
trust.subtitle: Unlike public social media groups, UniMarket protects you with identity verification and community accountability.

verification.title: Verified University IDs
verification.desc: Every active seller and requester submits a university ID reviewed by campus administrators. Verified badges are clearly shown.

twoSided.title: Two-Sided Deal Confirmation
twoSided.desc: Both the buyer and seller must confirm handover on their respective screens before a deal is officially recorded as completed.

ratings.title: Peer Ratings & Reviews
ratings.desc: Authentic 1-to-5 star feedback after completed deals helps you know who you are dealing with before meeting.

moderation.title: Community Moderation & Reporting
moderation.desc: Listings with 3 distinct reports are automatically hidden for admin review. Repeated violations lead to account suspension.

notice.title: Campus Safe Meetup Notice
notice.text: Always meet in open campus locations (Library entrance, Student Lounge, Cafeteria). Inspect the item thoroughly before paying. Payment happens in-person (cash or mobile transfer)—UniMarket does not hold funds in escrow.

faq.title: Got questions? We've got answers.
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about trading safely on the AAU campus network.

items.q1: Who can join and use UniMarket?
items.a1: Currently, UniMarket is tailored for Addis Ababa University (AAU) students, faculty, staff, and authorized campus service providers. You can browse publicly, but listing items and initiating deals requires campus verification.
items.a2: Yes, UniMarket is 100% free to join, browse, create listings, and post student demands.
items.a3: Payments happen directly and off-platform between the two parties when you meet on campus. You can pay with cash or direct mobile transfer (such as Telebirr or CBE). UniMarket does not process or hold payments online.
items.q4: How do I get my account verified?
items.a4: Navigate to the Verification tab in your profile and submit your AAU Student ID number or a clear photo of your campus ID card. University administrators review and approve valid submissions.
items.q5: What should I do if a deal or item is suspicious?
items.a5: Every listing and user profile features a 'Report' button. If a listing receives 3 reports, it is automatically hidden from the feed and forwarded to campus administration for investigation.
